claims.claim: Apple's Retention Messaging feature is available and can show text, images, or a special offer in the cancellation flow.

claims.source_title: Apple now lets developers offer discounts when users move to cancel subscriptions

claims.claim: Delhi Police Special Cell registered an FIR on October 8 over suspected child sexual abuse material on Meta platforms including Facebook and Instagram.

claims.source_title: Delhi Police registers FIR over alleged circulation of child sexual abuse material on Meta platforms
claims.supporting_quote: The FIR was registered on October 8 under Sections 67 (publishing or transmitting obscene material in electronic form) and 67B (publishing or transmitting material depicting children in sexually explicit acts or conduct in electronic form) of the Information Technology Act, 2000.

claims.claim: Approximately 10 links were flagged in the complaint.

claims.supporting_quote: Approximately 10 links were flagged in a complaint alleging the circulation of such material, following which the police initiated an investigation to verify the allegations, said Intelligence Fusion and Strategic Operations (IFSO) Additional CP Sanjay Bhatia.
